title: Abaco Carriage – 30A Beach Properties
description_expanded:
30-a Beach Properties presents the Abaco Carriage, located south of 30-A in Rosemary Beach, fully renovated, close to the beach, and Coquina pool. If you love tennis this location is for you - and it's also close to the beach. A full kitchen and great floor plan make this renovated carriage house clean, bright and comfortable. You will love the coziness of this charming carriage apt over the garage. Lots of windows, a large balcony, and proximity to Rosemary Beach cafes, pools and the beach itself make this a very popular property!

All towels, bed linens, blankets, and comforters are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

Located south of 30-A at 46 Abaco Lane in Rosemary Beach.

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

Features:1 NEW King bed

1 Full Sleeper Sofa

Renovated carriage house is clean, bright and comfortable.

Easy walk to beach via boardwalk A or B.

2 Tommy Bahama Carry Beach Chairs included (located on balcony)

1 minute from Coquina pool.

Bikes Available on request at a premium rate

Access to Main Street cafes and shops.

506 square feet

Fully stocked kitchen

No pets.

No smoking.

Features:

NEW washer/dryer

Fully Renovated Kitchen and Bathroom

Premium Bed Linens

Assigned Parking spot right outfront

Whole house water filtration system

Hardwood floors

Iron & ironing board

Access to all 4 Rosemary Beach pools

Tennis and fitness centers are daily fee
